doc.title: Gamedex — Noa Tournoy
doc.desc: Gamedex: a video game catalogue on the RAWG API. React, TypeScript, Vite. Search, filters, sorting, infinite scroll, persistent favourites, Cypress tests. Built as a pair.
lede: A video game catalogue built on the RAWG API: search, filters by platform and store, sorting, infinite scroll, detail pages, and favourites that survive a reload.
sujet.t: A real application, not a demo.
sujet.1: Five actual routes: the game list with search, filters and infinite scroll; a game's detail page with its description, trailer, achievements and their unlock rates, studios and publishers; every game from a publisher; favourites; and an error page that takes you somewhere.
sujet.2: Favourites live in a React context backed by local storage: the state persists without a server. The API key sits in an environment file that is never committed: it appears nowhere in the source.
sujet.3: Built as a pair with Antoine Delebecque, for the 2WEBD module. Type checking, static analysis and an end-to-end journey under Cypress are part of the repository's scripts.
colo.face: Set in Roboto Flex, opsz, wght, wdth and GRAD axes, subset to Latin, 235 KB. Scrolling holds the slider.
colo.hand: Written by hand: no dependencies, no third-party requests, no tracker. The text reads without JavaScript.
